product.name: Monoprice Heavy Duty Power Cord - NEMA 5-15P to IEC 60320 C15 14AWG 15A/1875W 125V SJT 15ft Black
product.description: This North America NEMA® 5‑15 plug to IEC 60320 C15 female connector power cord works with most PCs, monitors, scanners, and printers, as well as high temperature appliances, such as electric kettles.Connect your computer, monitor, power adapter, or other device with a male IEC 60320 C16 panel connector to a standard US AC wall outlet. The power cord features a standard, grounded NEMA 5‑15P plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C15 connector on the other end. Simply mate the female C15 connector with the male C16 connector on your device or power adapter, then plug the NEMA connector into a nearby AC power outlet, UPS, or other AC power source.
